summary: Short stretch across a junction mouth and turning bend; parking would block the road.
reasons: No clear ground beside the lane

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the south and homes 24 m or more away, but the spot itself is a junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The line runs along a give-way marking at the junction and a tight bend; no room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential junction, but a van would block turning vehicles.

flags: Junction and bend, markings across the stretch
sun_shade: Open road; dense tree canopy to the south and east.
